featured.name: BITSAA Company Ambassador Network
featured.description:
Introducing the BITSAA Company Ambassador Network (CAN)!

Hi everyone!

We’re excited to launch the BITSAA Company Ambassador Network (CAN)—a new initiative to connect BITSians within the companies we work at.

Just as BITSAA has city chapters around the world, we’re now building a network of Company Ambassadors across leading organizations like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Deloitte, Accenture, and many more. 

As a Company Ambassador, you’ll help:
* Connect BITSians within your company
* Organize BITS@Work meetups
* Share BITSAA updates with fellow alumni
* Foster referrals, mentorship, networking, and knowledge-sharing opportunities

This is a light-touch volunteer role that can make a meaningful difference to fellow BITSians while strengthening our professional alumni network.

Interested in becoming a Company Ambassador or know someone who would be a great fit?

Let’s build a stronger BITSian network—one company at a time! 💙

If you have questions or suggestions - reach out to Jaya Pavan at jaya.pavan@bitsaa.org

featured.name: Volunteer for BITSAA
featured.description:
🎉 Hey BITSIANS — Want to Build Cool Stuff with Other BITSIANS?

Ever missed the energy of late-night discussions, chaotic group projects, and doing something meaningful together?

BITSAA International is looking for enthusiastic volunteers to join teams where you:
+ Work with smart, driven alumni across the world
+ Build real initiatives (not just attend meetings)
+ Learn, experiment, and have fun along the way
No rigid hierarchy. No heavy time pressure. Just good people doing interesting things.


Teams You Can Join: People Strategy, Fundraising, Finance Team, Team Sahaaya, Alumni Mentorship Program (AMP), Chapter Relations Team, Marketing & Communications, Scholarships & Awards
More details here: https://lnkd.in/g6Uhkdcr

✨ What’s in it for you?
+ Make friends across batches & geographies to learn and grow along
+ Pick up leadership, strategy, and execution skills
+ Be part of initiatives that actually ship
And yes - contribute to the BITS ecosystem while having a great time doing it

Whether you’re:
+ Early in your career and excited to learn & experiment
+ Mid-career and keen to build, lead, and collaborate
+ A senior BITSIAN who enjoys mentoring and shaping direction
There’s a place for you here 🫶

Come for the people. Stay for the experience.
Let’s build something memorable. 🚀

donate.name:
BIT by BIT for BITS - 
60 years of BITS Pilani
donate.description:
**We are pleased to announce the launch of this year's BITSians' Day campaign - _Bit by Bit for BITS_ - aimed at garnering sustained support for the student community through our Monthly Giving Campaign**.

In 2022, we proudly awarded **$26K worth of scholarships** to support more than **100 students**- a remarkable achievement made possible by your philanthropic spirit. Alumni contributions have always been instrumental in nurturing and uplifting the next generation of BITSians.

**We invite you to join us in making this recurring donor drive a resounding success**. Even a modest pledge from us alumni can create an incredible impact for the students. 

_If a batch of 500 pledges to donate a dollar a day, they can potentially support Merit-cum-Needs scholarships for 40 students a year!_
